## 简体中文

### 知识库重构（macOS 与 Windows）
- 每个知识库分为 **简历、技能、项目、资料、自定义指令** 五部分，支持一键复制知识库，也可以把条目“复制到…”其他知识库。
- 上传简历时可以选择 **用 AI 整理** 或 **只保存原文**，可以记住选择，也可以在设置中修改。AI 会生成可编辑的 Markdown 原文、摘要和技能标签，摘要语言跟随简历原文。
- 简历中带链接的项目（GitHub 仓库、演示网站等）会自动加入“项目”；PDF / Word 中隐藏在文字后的超链接也能识别。
- 粘贴 GitHub 仓库或个人主页链接即可导入项目，并生成一句话摘要。

### 面试时主窗口自动让位
- 打开提示板（开始面试或 Director Mode 主机）时，主窗口自动最小化；开启“面试时隐藏任务栏 / 程序坞”后会完全隐藏。关闭提示板后自动恢复。

### Windows
- 新增 **安装版**（`…-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`，推荐）：无需管理员权限，开始菜单可搜索，可创建桌面快捷方式，可在“设置 → 应用”中卸载。便携版 exe 继续提供。
- **应用内更新**：发现新版本后点“立即更新”，在应用内下载（带进度）、安装并自动重新打开，数据和设置保留。从 1.1.0 升级需要手动下载这一次，之后就能在应用内更新。
- 更新提示、菜单等界面统一为应用风格。

### macOS
- 修复了侧边栏展开时 Director Mode 的排版问题。
- 数据目录选择现在直接使用所选文件夹；如果其中已有 `InterviewAssistant.store`，应用会在重启后加载原有数据，不再重复创建嵌套的 `InterviewAssistantData` 文件夹。

### 下载
| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-macOS.dmg` |
| Windows（推荐） | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Windows（便携版） | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-Windows-x64.exe` |

> Windows 版暂无代码签名证书。首次运行如果出现“Windows 已保护你的电脑”，点击 **更多信息 → 仍要运行**。

## English

### Knowledge bases, restructured (macOS & Windows)
- Each knowledge base now has **Resume, Skills, Projects, Materials and Custom instructions**. Duplicate a knowledge base in one click, or copy entries to another one.
- When uploading a resume, choose **Organize with AI** or **Save original only**. The choice can be remembered and changed in Settings. AI creates an editable Markdown original, a summary and skill tags, written in the resume's own language.
- Projects linked in the resume (GitHub repositories, demo sites…) are added to Projects automatically, including links hidden behind text in PDF / Word files.
- Paste a GitHub repository or profile link to import projects with a one-line summary.

### Main window steps aside during interviews
- Opening the prompt board (an interview or the Director Mode host) minimizes the main window, or hides it completely when "hide from taskbar / Dock" is on. It comes back when the board closes.

### Windows
- New **installer** (`…-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`, recommended): no administrator rights, Start menu entry, optional desktop shortcut, uninstall from Settings → Apps. The portable exe is still available.
- **In-app updates**: click "Update Now" to download with progress, install and reopen the app, keeping your data and settings. Updating from 1.1.0 needs one manual download; later updates happen in the app.
- Update prompts and menus now use the app's own style.

### macOS
- Fixed the Director Mode layout when the sidebar is open.
- Data Storage now uses the selected folder directly. If it already contains `InterviewAssistant.store`, the app loads that data after restart instead of creating nested `InterviewAssistantData` folders.

### Downloads
| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-macOS.dmg` |
| Windows (recommended) | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Windows (portable) | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.1-Windows-x64.exe` |

> The Windows build is not code-signed yet. If SmartScreen appears on first launch, click **More info → Run anyway**.
